unit: Bounded serialisation fuzz target and CI gate
notes: Deterministic xorshift mutation over the committed tests/fixtures/serialization-fuzz corpus for JSON/YAML/TOML/INI; corpus seeds are hash-pinned in manifest.sha256 and include byte copies of the v10 settings and extension-manifest goldens; bounded 120 s wall-clock and 50M iteration budgets, 2 s per-case hang timeout, 256 MiB managed-heap ceiling, 64 KiB parser limit, structured malformed/deep-nesting/oversized probes; linux-ci fails on a nonzero exit or a missing FUZZ COMPLETE marker; aggregates parent-owned
